title: Proper scalar and tensor square
statement: For any normalized scalar/tensor models and choices [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data], finite commutative coefficient rings A,B, coefficient map φ:A→B, scheme morphism g:Z→Y, and arbitrary unbounded M over Z and L over Y, use the proper factor maps [def-sf-concrete-projection-factors]. Scalar extension of the A counit projection, followed by properScalar on M tensor Lg*L and proper image of the inputComparison [def-sf-concrete-projection-reduction-data], equals the scalar tensorator followed by tensor(properScalar M, identity) and the B counit projection on scalar M and scalar L. This is equality of the specified B-linear arrows; neither properScalar nor the proper projection is asserted invertible.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6, 0D6D, 0E48; more-etale.tex Tags 0GL1 and 0GL6. Concrete proper/open argument of fix-prop-projection-formula, proof sentence 2.

proof.text: The scalar counit equation in lem-sp-proper-scalar-counit-square identifies the scalar-adjunction mate properComparison with directImageScalarComparison: apply the scalar Hom bijection and the inverse mates equivalence. Transport through the specified scalarIso factors; naturality of the geometric unit and scalar presentation identifies properScalar with the geometric mate of lambda.

Apply the universe-polymorphic tensor_mate_coherence calculation of lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence to the actual geometric adjunctions, scalar tensorators and restriction tensorators. Its tensor-square hypothesis is exactly lem-sf-scalar-pullback-tensor-coherence. The resulting arrows are definitionally properProjection and inputComparison.

lean.statement:
theorem proper_scalar_tensor_square
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (M : proEtaleDerivedCategory Z A) (L : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A) :
    (scalar m φ Y).map (properProjection m A g M L) ≫
      (properScalar m φ g).app (input m A g M L) ≫
      (properImage B g).map (inputComparison m choices φ g M L).hom =
    (choices.scalarTensor φ Y).iso.hom.app ((properImage A g).obj M, L) ≫
      (tensor m B Y).map (Prod.mkHom ((properScalar m φ g).app M) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      properProjection m B g ((scalar m φ Z).obj M) ((scalar m φ Y).obj L)
